modifications: Latin subset faces only: the PostScript name is replaced by a unique name of the same length (NotoSansLatinX-Regular, NotoSansLatinX-Bold), so libass does not confuse them with the Arabic faces. Noto Sans Arabic declares no Reserved Font Name. All four faces: usWinAscent and usWinDescent are set to 905 and 212 (sum 1117, the Arial proportion). libass sizes a face from these two values, so captions draw at the requested size, as they do with Arial; the hhea and typo metrics are unchanged. Table and file checksums are recomputed.
purpose: FFmpeg libass caption faces for the Arabic and Latin subsets; the WOFF2 faces in the parent folder stay for browsers
